## RH-38 — `apps/web/AGENTS.md` Critical Gotchas lifted; measured sizes

Codex's context cap is 32 KiB per file-read family. Measured at `d24dbed8`:

| File | Bytes | Lines |
| ---- | ----- | ----- |
| `AGENTS.md` (root) | 15,072 | 208 |
| `apps/web/AGENTS.md` | 15,747 → 15,747 | 223 → 223 |
| root + web combined | 30,819 (≈ 94% of 32,768 B) | — |

Each file alone fits under 32,768 B, but web work loads root + web together — 30.8 KB is
close enough to the cap that a truncated read was plausible, and the web file's `## Critical
Gotchas` previously sat at :174–213, **after** ~150 lines of Key Files/Build & Test/Conventions/
Shell/Primitives/ReadOnlyProject/Demo/Keymap. The section is now moved **verbatim** to :21,
immediately after `## Architecture` and before `## Key Files`, so a truncated read still reaches
it. The move is line-set identical (`diff <(sort a) <(sort b)` empty — pure reorder, no bytes
added or lost). Root `AGENTS.md`'s gotchas sit at :133 of 208 behind shorter sections; the
finding names only the web file, so root is unchanged (recorded as a judgement call).
